Use this skill when a covered file's header is not the standard PK\\x03\\x04 (ZIP) or D0CF11E0 (OLE) signature, when reading a file returns garbage or a marker such as %TSD-Header, effsoftecrypt, cdg or 00005b00, when the user mentions 文档加密 / 透明加密 / DLP / 加密软件, or when a covered file must be written without breaking its encryption. Two cooperating channels: a Node.js MCP server covering Office (.xlsx/.xls/.doc/.docx/.ppt/.pptx/.mdb/.accdb), PDF, WPS (.wps/.et/.dps), OpenDocument (.odt/.ods/.odp), RTF, email (.eml/.msg), CAD (.dwg/.dxf), archives and plain-text / source-code files through whitelisted Office/WPS/Outlook/AutoCAD COM apps or 7-Zip/LibreOffice CLIs, plus a pywin32 structured channel (scripts/*.py, 11 scripts) that extends Word and Excel to PowerPoint slides and speaker notes, Access records, WPS .et cells, Acrobat-based PDF page editing and Office-to-PDF export, and a DLP write-policy probe. Windows + interactive desktop only. Read paths open documents read-only and never save the source file. Do NOT use it on machines without such DLP software, for scanned image-only PDFs (no OCR), or for plain files whose content is already readable by the built-in tools.
skills.description_zh: Use this skill when an AI Agent (WorkBuddy, Claude Code, Cursor, Cline, etc.) must read or write Office files (.xlsx/.xls/.doc/.docx/.ppt/.pptx/.mdb/.accdb), PDF files (.pdf), WPS Office files (.wps/.et/.dps), OpenDocument files (.odt/.ods/.odp), Rich Text Format (.rtf), email files (.eml/.msg), CAD drawings (.dwg/.dxf), archives (.zip/.rar/.7z/.tar/.gz/.tgz/.bz2), or plain-text / source-code files (.txt/.md/.csv/.json/.log/.xml/.html/.py/.js/.ts/.java/.c/.cpp/.sql/.yaml/.ini) that are protected by transparent-encryption DLP software (ESAFENET, TianRui Green Shield, IP-Guard, DSE) and whose built-in Read/Write tools return only ciphertext. It provides a Node.js MCP Server pattern that reads/writes encrypted files as plaintext by delegating to whitelisted apps (Office/WPS/Outlook/AutoCAD COM or 7-Zip/LibreOffice CLI) via PowerShell, delegating to the existing DLP whitelist (the DLP policy is respected) for Node/Python. Includes a headless-safe Word path and a diagnosis procedure to find which processes are on the encryption-software trust whitelist.
skills.name: transparent-encrypt-file-mcp
